description: This file defines extension methods for configuring AdoNet grain storage in Orleans silo builders, providing various overloads to set up default or named storage with optional configuration actions.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainStorageSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to configure AdoNet grain storage in Orleans silo builders.

methods.name: AddAdoNetGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the Orleans silo to use AdoNet grain storage as the default storage, with a configuration action for options.

methods.name: AddAdoNetGrainStorage
methods.description: Configures the Orleans silo to use AdoNet grain storage with a specified name and options.

methods.name: AddAdoNetGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the silo to use AdoNet grain storage as the default with options wrapped in OptionsBuilder.

methods.name: AddAdoNetGrainStorage
methods.description: Configures the silo to use AdoNet grain storage with a given name and optional configuration wrapped in OptionsBuilder.
